settings_section_japan_desc: Extra data sources for Japan: GSI buildings and elevation, satellite colors and PLATEAU heights.
gsi_buildings_desc: GSI building polygons and GSI DEM terrain (Japan only).
satellite_colors_desc: Building wall colors sampled from satellite imagery.
plateau_heights_desc: Accurate building heights from the PLATEAU 3D city model. Experimental.
gsi3d_heights_desc: Needs a separately obtained GML file. CLI only (--gsi-3d).
tooltip_gsi_buildings: Use building and elevation data from Japan's Geospatial Information Authority (国土地理院). Provides much more building coverage for Japan than OSM alone, and switches terrain to the GSI DEM.
tooltip_satellite_colors: Determine building colors from satellite imagery instead of random presets. May not work correctly in some cases.
tooltip_plateau_heights: Use building height data from PLATEAU (国土交通省 3D都市モデル). Provides accurate building heights for supported cities. Experimental feature.
tooltip_gsi3d_heights: Use GSI 3D building height data (国土地理院 3D建物データ). Requires a separately obtained GML file. Currently CLI-only (--gsi-3d).
settings_section_area_desc: How big the world is built and which part of the map it covers.
settings_section_mapview_desc: How the map you pick your area on looks.
settings_section_perceived_desc: Sizes that look real to a Minecraft player.
perceived_size_desc: Turns on every item below and sets World Scale to 1.4.
wide_roads_desc: Each lane is 3.25 m × scale × (scale − 0.1): 6 blocks at scale 1.4.
bare_bicycle_parking_desc: Only a floor: no roof, posts or walls.
fill_split_buildings_desc: Raises the low pieces of a building split into several shapes to its tallest piece.
elevated_height_desc: Blocks per elevated level and under it. Arnis uses 6.
